title: COVID-19 and (ir)responsible mobility:  Reading counter-practices through Derrida
descriptions: During the COVID-19 pandemic, issues of (civic) (ir)responsibility were raised virtually every time people broke immobility rules. I have investigated the relationship between mobility and (ir)responsibility by focussing on the creative modalities through which (some) people in Paris circumvented mobility restrictions. Here I provide the transcripts of the interviews carried out between November and December 2022. These interviews have been conducted as part of the following: MOBILISE project - Marie Skłodowska-Curie grant agreement no. 101024492: ‘MOBILISE: Stay home: Emergency, (im)mobility, and the liberal subject’, and included in the following article: COVID-19 and (ir)responsible mobility: Reading counter-practices through Derrida, submitted in Open Research Europe, in the collection ‘The Future of Democracy’.
